Welcome to 1012 Muelhause St in Belton, TX, a well-located 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home situated in the highly sought-after Belton ISD. This property offers a comfortable layout, functional living spaces, and an excellent opportunity for buyers looking to own a home in Central Texas.

📍 Located close to shopping, restaurants, schools, and Baylor Scott & White Hospital, and conveniently positioned for an easy commute to Temple, Killeen, and Fort Hood / Fort Cavazos, this home is ideal for first-time buyers, VA buyers, military families, and medical professionals.

If you’ve been searching for homes for sale in Belton Texas, this is one you don’t want to miss. Schedule your private showing today and see why this home stands out in today’s market.
